title: Discover sessions
scenario: Find suitable public upcoming sessions without requiring sign in.
prerequisites: Healthy configured service; seeded public/private, open/cancelled, full/non-full sessions. Use a fixed clock T. Start each subcase with cleared filters.

cases.action: Open Discover anonymously, then while signed in.
cases.inputs: Same fixture and empty filters.
cases.expected: Both visitors can view the same public results. Joining may separately require sign in.

cases.action: Refresh the list for each fixture.
cases.inputs: PUBLIC/PRIVATE; OPEN/CANCELLED; full/non-full; future start.
cases.expected: Only PUBLIC and OPEN sessions appear. A full eligible session remains listed.

cases.action: Search with the server clock fixed at T.
cases.inputs: Starts T-1ms, T, T+1ms.
cases.expected: Only the session starting at T+1ms appears.

cases.action: Submit each search text independently.
cases.inputs: Empty; mixed-case matching venue; no match; literal % or _.
cases.expected: Empty gives unrestricted results; matching is case-insensitive; no match gives an empty state; wildcard characters are literal.

cases.action: Submit query q using the API or filter form.
cases.inputs: 99, 100 and 101 characters after trimming.
cases.expected: 99 and 100 are accepted; 101 is rejected with a search validation error.

cases.action: Filter 1 Nov 2026, 18:00 to 20:00 Singapore time.
cases.expected: Include the middle two sessions; the lower bound is inclusive and upper bound exclusive.

cases.action: Submit each malformed query separately.
cases.inputs: Impossible date; time without date; equal/reversed times; duplicate sport; unknown sport.
cases.expected: Validation fails for the affected field. No successful result set is presented for the invalid query.

cases.action: Load results and follow the returned next cursor.
cases.inputs: 0, 1, 20 and 21 matching sessions.
cases.expected: Empty state for 0; correct results for 1 and 20; first page has 20 for 21 matches, with the final result on the next page and no duplicates.

title: Create a session
scenario: Create one valid session and reject invalid submissions without saving a session.
prerequisites: Active booker with email and completed payout setup. Baseline cost 1001c, 3 slots, minimum headcount 2, nonblank venue, future start and later end. Use a fresh idempotency key per independent subcase.

cases.action: POST /api/sessions using an authenticated API harness.
cases.inputs: Baseline; omit chosen price and visibility.
cases.expected: Exactly one session is created, initially PRIVATE, with a 333c share and generated invitation identity. Creation moves no funds.

cases.action: Submit each slot value separately.
cases.inputs: totalSlots 1, 2, 29, 30, 31 and 2.5.
cases.expected: Integers 2, 29 and 30 succeed. 1, 31 and 2.5 fail; no session is saved for rejected values.

cases.action: Keep capacity 3 and vary minimum headcount.
cases.expected: 2 and 3 succeed. 1, 4 and 2.5 fail without saving.

cases.action: Submit a chosen price for the baseline booking.
cases.expected: 167-666 whole cents are accepted. 166, 667 and fractional cents fail. Omission uses 333c.

cases.action: Vary one field per submission.
cases.inputs: Cost -1, 0, 2, 3, 4 cents; reliability -1, 0, 50.5, 100, 101.
cases.expected: With 3 slots, costs 3 and 4 yield 1c; lower values fail. Finite reliability 0-100 is accepted, including 50.5; out-of-range values fail.

cases.action: Submit with a controlled clock.
cases.inputs: Start T-1ms, T, T+1ms; separately end start-1ms, start, start+1ms.
cases.expected: Only a strictly future start and a strictly positive duration are accepted. Check millisecond cases through the API harness.

cases.action: Submit once per account/input state.
cases.inputs: Missing/inactive booker; missing email; incomplete payout; blank venue.
cases.expected: Each is rejected with the relevant account/input error and no created session. Restore all other baseline conditions per subcase.

cases.action: Submit; simulate lost response; retry the identical payload and key.
cases.inputs: Same authenticated booker, payload and idempotency key.
cases.expected: Return the original creation result. Exactly one session exists; the retry creates no duplicate.

title: Change session visibility
scenario: Allow an eligible owner to set PUBLIC or PRIVATE while protecting capacity and lifecycle rules.
prerequisites: Active owner and separate non-owner account. OPEN future session with at least one available place. Keep an independent Discover page open for propagation cases.

cases.action: In hosted sessions, set visibility to PUBLIC.
cases.inputs: Eligible owner; PRIVATE session; one free place.
cases.expected: Success shows confirmed PUBLIC state. A healthy visible online Discover page includes it within the three-second target.

cases.action: Set visibility to PRIVATE.
cases.inputs: Eligible PUBLIC session.
cases.expected: Success confirms PRIVATE. The healthy foreground discovery list removes it within three seconds.

cases.action: Request the change using each rejected identity.
cases.inputs: Non-owner; inactive owner; unauthenticated request.
cases.expected: Access is rejected; stored visibility is unchanged. API responses are 403 for foreign/inactive access and 401 without authentication.

cases.action: Request PUBLIC and PRIVATE separately.
cases.inputs: One available place; zero available places, including replacement reservations.
cases.expected: One available place permits the change. Zero rejects either target; a reserved place does not count as available.

cases.action: Change visibility using a fixed clock.
cases.inputs: Server time start-1ms and exactly start.
cases.expected: The first succeeds; exactly start fails. Time is evaluated after authoritative state is loaded.

cases.action: Submit the current visibility again.
cases.inputs: Eligible session; separately full, closed or foreign-owned session.
cases.expected: Eligible same-value request succeeds. Ineligible same-value requests still fail; no shortcut bypasses guards.

cases.action: Call the visibility endpoint with each input.
cases.inputs: Bad session UUID; valid UUID with visibility public, null or missing; valid PUBLIC/PRIVATE.
cases.expected: Malformed values return 400. Exact valid enum values reach the workflow.

cases.action: Make the save/commit fail in a test environment.
cases.inputs: Eligible visibility request; injected transaction failure.
cases.expected: An error is shown and no successful committed value is reported. After rollback, the persisted visibility remains unchanged.

title: Remove a participant
scenario: Remove an eligible committed participant and refund the historical held amount once.
prerequisites: Active owner, OPEN future session and a COMMITTED target with a 733c held amount. Read the removal preview before confirmation. Use fixture accounts and funds.

cases.action: Open Manage participants, preview the target and confirm.
cases.inputs: Current preview; committed target; new UUID idempotency key.
cases.expected: Refund 733c to the participant wallet; retain REMOVED history; free capacity; session stays OPEN. The removed participant cannot rejoin.

cases.action: Remove a fresh target at each time before start.
cases.inputs: 48h, exactly 30h, 5h and 1s before start.
cases.expected: Each refunds the full historical 733c. Participant withdrawal fees do not apply to booker removal.

cases.action: Request removal for each target state.
cases.inputs: WAITLISTED, LEFT_WAITLIST, WITHDRAWN or REMOVED.
cases.expected: Each is rejected as an invalid state. No additional refund or saved removal occurs.

cases.action: Request the list/preview/removal with each fixture.
cases.inputs: Foreign owner; inactive owner; missing user/session/participation.
cases.expected: No unauthorized private data or mutation. Foreign/inactive access is rejected; missing required records produce not-found errors.

cases.action: Confirm with a current preview at the boundary.
cases.inputs: Exactly session start; separately cancelled session.
cases.expected: Removal fails; no refund is committed and stored participation remains unchanged.

cases.action: Preview, change fixture state, then confirm.
cases.inputs: Change held amount while COMMITTED; separately only visibility or an unrelated participant.
cases.expected: Changed hold requires a fresh preview and confirmation. Unrelated changes preserve validity. A target that becomes WITHDRAWN/REMOVED is rejected as ineligible.

cases.action: Confirm; lose the response; reload and retry the saved request.
cases.inputs: Identical user, target, payload and key; active account.
cases.expected: Return the original result, including after start, without another refund. Preserve the key during recovery.

cases.action: Inject ledger/save/commit failure; separately complete a valid removal.
cases.inputs: Fresh fixtures with a waiting participant.
cases.expected: Failure commits no removal/refund. Success frees capacity while retaining FIFO priority and reservations; this removal call performs no automatic promotion.

title: Cancel a session
scenario: Cancel an eligible session, refund outstanding holds and preserve terminal participant history.
prerequisites: Active owner and an OPEN future session. Seed committed, waitlisted and previously removed/refunded records. Read a fresh cancellation preview before confirming.

cases.action: Open cancellation preview and confirm.
cases.inputs: Two committed participants holding 500c and 733c.
cases.expected: Session becomes CANCELLED; the preview and result identify two refund recipients and total 1233c. Wallet refunds occur once.

cases.action: Cancel each session with a fresh preview.
cases.inputs: No participants; separately all slots occupied.
cases.expected: Both are cancellable before start. Empty refunds total 0; full refunds outstanding holds. Cancellation is not blocked by fullness.

cases.action: Cancel the mixed participant-list fixture.
cases.inputs: COMMITTED/HELD; WAITLISTED/no hold; REMOVED/REFUNDED.
cases.expected: Live records become CANCELLED; outstanding holds refund; waitlist produces no refund; REMOVED history stays REMOVED with no second refund.

cases.action: Attempt cancellation for each rejected condition.
cases.inputs: Non-owner; inactive owner; exactly start; closed session.
cases.expected: Reject access or lifecycle violation. No new cancellation or refund is committed.

cases.action: Preview; change participant/hold state; confirm the old version.
cases.inputs: Changed participant list or held amount after preview; session still eligible.
cases.expected: Return a stale-preview conflict; require a fresh preview and explicit confirmation; do not commit old refund assumptions.

cases.action: Preview; change visibility; confirm.
cases.inputs: Unchanged participants/holds/lifecycle with a new PUBLIC/PRIVATE value.
cases.expected: Visibility alone does not invalidate the cancellation preview. Eligible cancellation succeeds.

cases.action: Repeat the identical confirmed request.
cases.inputs: Same key and payload after cancellation or after start; active owner.
cases.expected: Return the original success and refund totals with no second refund or write.

cases.action: Inject commit failure; separately perform a successful cancellation.
cases.inputs: Held funds and an open foreground Discover page.
cases.expected: Failure leaves stored state and funds unchanged. Success removes the session from healthy foreground discovery within three seconds. Venue booking cancellation remains external.
